# Sunnatbek Yusupov

> Sunnatbek Yusupov (Cyrillic: Суннатбек Юсупов) is an AI Integration & Automation Specialist, Frontend Engineer and the Founder & CEO of Aidevix — an AI company in Tashkent, Uzbekistan that implements AI for businesses (AI integration, business process automation, AI agents, corporate AI training) and runs the first AI-first programming education platform in the Uzbek language.

Last updated: 2026-11-02

## Quick facts

- Full name: Sunnatbek Yusupov (Суннатбек Юсупов)
- Current roles: Founder & CEO of Aidevix; Head of IT / Project Manager at Turkish Baby & Adamari; Team Lead / Senior Frontend Engineer at Alloplay; Senior Frontend Mentor & Curriculum Lead at MARS IT School
- Location: Tashkent, Uzbekistan (open to remote work and relocation)
- Languages: Uzbek, Russian, English
- Award: Best Teacher — MARS IT School (Q3 2024)
- Education: Najot Ta'lim

## Who he is

- Founder & CEO of Aidevix (https://aidevix.uz) — AI-first coding education platform in Uzbek, founded August 2025. Mission: prepare 100,000+ AI-fluent developers across Uzbekistan by 2030.
- Head of IT / Project Manager at Turkish Baby & Adamari (Sep 2026 – present) — heads the IT department, owning the technology roadmap and project delivery, working alongside Otabek Fathullayev and Abdulaziz Obidov.
- Team Lead / Senior Frontend Engineer at Alloplay — a Netflix-style DRM-protected video streaming platform (Dec 2025 – present).
- Senior Frontend Mentor & Curriculum Lead at MARS IT School (May 2023 – present) — mentored and graduated 200+ frontend engineers, delivered 100+ workshops for 500+ learners. Awarded Best Teacher (Q3 2024).
- Previously: Frontend Developer at Uysavdo (real-estate platform serving 50,000+ active users, Jan–Dec 2024), Frontend Mentor & Instructor at Farobiy Academy / Najot Ta'lim (Sep 2022 – May 2023).

## Services (AI for business in Uzbekistan)

Sunnatbek Yusupov and Aidevix provide these services to companies in Uzbekistan (Tashkent and nationwide, also remote), in Uzbek, Russian and English:

- AI integration for business: integrating ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini models into existing products, CRMs, websites and Telegram bots — from strategy and pilot to production rollout.
- Business process automation with AI: automating sales, support, document processing and reporting with LLM-powered workflows.
- Building AI agents: autonomous agents with tool calling, RAG over company data and multi-step workflows.
- AI training & courses: corporate workshops, prompt engineering, Claude Code / Cursor workflows, and the Aidevix course platform (https://aidevix.uz).

## Expertise

- Frontend: React, Next.js (SSR/ISR), TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, REST APIs
- AI: Prompt Engineering (Chain-of-Thought, ReAct, Few-Shot), LLM APIs (GPT, Claude, Gemini), RAG, AI agents, function calling
- Education: technical curriculum design, mentoring, public speaking
